evals.prompt: Build my voice corpus. My YouTube is @mychannel and my Instagram is @myhandle.
evals.expected_output: Should rank YouTube uploads with yt-top.sh and write entries with yt-entry.sh, run one Apify scrape of the Instagram handle and pipe the dataset through ig-entries.sh, tag every entry with tag.py until zero TODOs remain, regenerate voice-corpus/index.md with build-index.py, draft voice-dna.md from reference/voice-dna-template.md with every bullet grounded in quoted corpus lines and counts, and verify with find_voice.py --list.
assertions: Uses yt-top.sh and yt-entry.sh for YouTube
Uses one Apify scrape plus ig-entries.sh for Instagram
Tags every entry until no TODOs remain
Grounds every voice-dna.md bullet in quoted corpus lines
